task: Make GET /v1/schedulers accept multiple projectId and resourceId values (repeated query params, OR semantics) in the backend while keeping the non-admin project restriction.

key_reasoning.reason: Highest two: router list_schedulers (two Query params) and SchedulerSettingsService.list_schedulers/_build_list_filters (two filter blocks); two layers, one endpoint, single production caller chain.

Closest patterns: activity_events_router list[str] Query and the in-function s.project_name = ANY(:project_names) binding. Both cover the mechanics. The security-relevant non-admin scope is a separate ANDed condition that stays untouched, but AC 5 has test coverage only for the single-id case and no test executes the SQL or FastAPI query parsing, so rated M rather than S.
